# Reference-encoder compatibility manifest.
# One SHA-256 per (corpus WAV, quality) triple. Produced by the pristine
# upstream encoder (r475 / git 05d97a5) built WITHOUT optimization (the
# default CMake build type, matching the CI Unix test build).
#
# Encoder byte-identity is optimization-dependent (verified: ref -O0 == mod -O0
# and ref -O3 == mod -O3, 0/693 differs either way; -O0 vs -O3 differ in 1/189
# manifest cases, e.g. clipping_edge q7). Regenerate with the reference build
# at the same optimization as the mpcenc under test if you change build type.
#
# Re-frozen for the MusicPack encoder version bump 1.30.1 -> 1.32.0: the
# encoder version is embedded in the SV8 EI (encoder info) block, so the
# whole-file hashes change even though the codec output (audio packets,
# decoded PCM) is bit-identical. Generated with the patched reference
# encoder (tests/patch_reference.py normalizes its version to 1.32.0) on
# Apple clang 21 (arm64) at -O0. CI uses live-mode REF_MPCENC comparison and
# does not depend on this manifest.
# Format: <wav-basename> <quality> <sha256>
